ref_speedup_note: Anchor 2.99 calibrated in oracle mode on NVIDIA H20. tests/ref_speedup.txt is authoritative at scoring; this file is only the in-image fallback. See tests/ref_speedup.caveat.md to re-measure on your hardware.
value_axis: achieved_fp32_gflops / arithmetic intensity (compute-bound; wall-time tracks it). gpu_bench.py prints achieved-GFLOP/s per shape as work evidence; a register-tiled win sits well above the naive one-element-per-thread roofline.
compile_note: sgemm.py JIT-compiles sgemm_kernel.cu with nvcc (torch cpp-extension) at scoring; a changed .cu forces a fresh recompile. Requires nvcc + CUDA headers + ninja in the image (see the Dockerfile build notes); H20 = sm_90; -ccbin g++-11 fallback. Proven on the sibling fp16-tensorcore-mma-gemm (same base image, validated).
